With almost 3,000 programs in over 130 countries, the organization offers help to children, young people and families in need through education, medical care and family strengthening. The focus is on strengthening the family, sustainability, children's rights and cultural sensitivity.   To support our Scholarships & Educational Development team in our Munich office, we are looking for a (Junior) Program Manager - Scholar Support & Quality (m/f/d) on a full time basis. Your tasks As (Junior) Program Manager - Scholar Support & Quality, take operational ownership of scholar support, program quality, and MEAL within the Global Scholarship Program (GSP). This includes the following tasks: Program Quality, MEAL & Impact: Develop & manage a safeguarding-informed GSP quality and MEAL framework. Coordinate data collection, analysis and reporting and ensure findings are translated into concrete program improvements. Coordinate impact measurement approaches, including SROI, and lead the preparation of the GSP annual report. Provide administrative support to the team Scholar Support & Documentation: Manage and coordinate the scholar support process throughout their journey. Maintain and update scholar information as well as all relevant documents (communications, reports, transcripts) in appropriate databases and tools. Schedule check-ins & respond promptly to general inquiries from students and stakeholders. Serve as the primary contact for scholar inquiries on YouthLinks Community (an internal communication platform), by coordinating, developing, and posting relevant information, guidance, and support materials for scholars. Prepare reports as required        Your profile You have successfully completed studies in social work, psychology, youth development, social sciences, education, international development, public policy or a related field. You bring initial relevant professional experience in one or more areas such as student or youth support, program quality, monitoring and evaluation. Skills in MHPSS are an advantage. You are highly organized and approach routine and recurring tasks with diligence and understand their importance for effective scholar support, monitoring and program management. You are proactive and bring forward innovative ideas for improvements. You are a team player with a positive attitude, hands-on-mentality and get things done. You are flexible in navigating a complex and fast changing environment and have the ability to prioritize effectively when faced with multiple requests. You have effective communication skills with excellent command of English. Another foreign language such as Spanish, Portuguese, German, Arabic or French is an advantage. You have very good skills in MS-Office, Adobe & Canva. Additional computer skills are a plus. Location: Global

Department: DI AUT IT AIDA AI 2

The official start of this Leadership role is planned for October 1st 2026. As part of our transformation towards ONE Tech Company it plays a key role in shaping the future of our organization.

What we offer you

- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests
- (Global) development programs that can be customized according to your wishes and ambitions
- Diverse health and wellness offerings
- A work environment where you can contribute with your whole personality and truly feel like part of Siemens

At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and devleopment opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

Transform the everyday.

In this role, you will lead a team of Applied AI Engineers working closely with Siemens DI functions to identify, design, deliver, and operate impactful AI solutions. You will help stakeholders understand what is possible with AI, translate domain challenges into concrete impactful use cases, and guide solutions from early discovery through prototype, MVP, and production readiness.

How you will make an Impact with us

- Lead a team of Applied AI Engineers delivering impactful AI solutions for Siemens DI business functions.
- Partner with domain/functions experts and business stakeholders to transform internal processes with AI.
- Translate business pain points or business process into clear AI use cases, technical solution concepts, value KPIs, and delivery plans.
- Guide AI solutions from consulting and PoV/prototype through MVP and production-ready operation.
- Provide technical leadership on AI architecture, software engineering, evaluation, monitoring, and security.
- Coach AI engineers in both technical excellence and stakeholder-facing consulting.
- Build trust with senior stakeholders by explaining AI opportunities, limitations, risks, and value potential.
- Ensure AI solutions are robust, secure, maintainable, compliant, and measurable.
- Collaborate with DI IT, HUB, platform teams, cybersecurity, legal, worker-council stakeholders, product teams, and domain organizations.

What you bring

- 5+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, or software engineering.
- 2+ years of experience leading AI engineers/ Data Scientist, or complex cross-functional technical software initiatives.
- Proven hands-on experience designing, building, and delivering AI/ML solutions cloud first, including evaluation, guardrails, and observability.
- Strong software engineering foundation, including Python, APIs, data pipelines, CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and production operations in the cloud.
- Ability to communicate effectively with both executives and AI engineers.
- Strong business-value orientation and ability to define measurable business outcomes and drive the technical implantation to measure them after go live.
- Experience in enterprise environments with security, compliance, data governance, and integration constraints.
- High ownership, pragmatic judgment, and the ability to create clarity in ambiguous situations.
- In this role, your focus will be on sales (configuration, pricing, quoting, sales ops & performance) related business functions and SHERPA related use cases.

You are the right person if

- You can walk into a domain conversation, understand the real process, and identify where AI could create value.
- You are obsessed with creating real measurable impact with AI
- You can inspire stakeholders with what is possible, helping them transform the way they work in their departments with AI, while staying grounded in feasibility, data, risk, and measurable impact.
- You can guide your team in architecture and challenge engineering decisions.
- You enjoy developing people and raising the engineering bar.
- You want to build AI solutions that move beyond demos and become sustainable, production-ready capabilities.

Languages: Fluent in English, additional languages are a plus

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

Please note, this position will be based in the Siemens location where the selected candidate currently is located. The role has been assessed as a level (TL999). We're looking for an organized, warm and proactive Office Manager who enjoys bringing structure to everyday operations while creating an environment where employees and visitors feel genuinely welcome.
So, what can you expect to work on?
• Working hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00-14:00 (30 hours/week).
• Welcome employees, candidates, suppliers and visitors, ensuring everyone has a positive experience from the moment they arrive.
• Manage incoming deliveries, parcels and mail, and coordinate distribution with the relevant teams.
• Coordinate office supply orders, monitor inventory levels and optimize ordering processes where needed.
• Research and communicate with suppliers to find the best office solutions and services.
• Organize flowers, gifts and other thoughtful touches for birthdays, anniversaries and special occasions.
• Continuously improve office processes and help create an inspiring, well-organized working environment.
• Support the planning and execution of internal events, team events and company celebrations.
• Assist with administrative tasks related to employee onboarding and offboarding.
• Help ensure our office reflects the premium experience and attention to detail our brands stand for.

What you offer us
• You have previous experience in an Office Manager, Workplace Experience, Front Office or similar administrative role.
• You genuinely enjoy working with people and have a warm, welcoming and service-oriented personality.
• You are highly organized, reliable and able to manage multiple priorities independently.
• You proactively identify opportunities to improve processes and enjoy making things run smoothly.
• You have a hands-on mindset and are happy to support wherever needed.
• You identify with our values around healthy living, conscious nutrition and premium products.
• You communicate confidently in both German and English

What does Yoshi en offer
• Attractive employee discount on all Yoshi en & Edeneve products.
• 28 days of paid vacation plus up to 5 additional days off between Christmas and New Year.
• Urban Sports Club membership and a subsidy for your BVG ticket.
• Access to a wide range of employee discounts across shopping, travel and technology.
• A high level of ownership, short decision-making paths and plenty of room to contribute your ideas from day one.
• Work from our beautiful office at Grasblau , a modern and sustainable workspace in Berlin with plenty of natural light, quiet rooms, inspiring meeting spaces and an environment designed for focus and collaboration.
• Enjoy unlimited premium organic teas and regular tea tastings as part of everyday office life.
• We love bringing people together! From tea ceremonies and office gatherings to summer and Christmas parties, product launches and exclusive influencer events, there are plenty of opportunities to celebrate and connect as a team.

About usAs a multi-brand company, we bring together brands such as Yoshi en, Edeneve and Dr. Schweikart , all founded by entrepreneur Jörg Schweikart as independent sister brands of Sunday Natural. While each brand has its own identity, products and stage of growth, they are united by a shared commitment to quality, innovation, fairness and naturalness.Our teams work from Grasblau in Berlin, a modern and sustainable office with plenty of natural light, quiet rooms and spaces designed for collaboration and focused work.

jobs.employer_name: Max-Planck-Institut für die Physik des Lichts
jobs.description:
About us

The Max-Planck-Zentrum für Physik und Medizin (MPZPM) is an interdisciplinary joint research center of the Max Planck Institute for the Science of Light (MPL), Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg (FAU), and Universitätsklinikum Erlangen (UKER). Research at MPZPM addresses fundamental questions in medicine, aiming to understand living systems, biological processes, and their pathological changes from a novel physical perspective.

Facility Leader - Lab-on-a-Chip (LoC) Facility at MPZPM
Core Facilities (CF) at MPZPM provide cutting-edge technologies and form an essential part of the center’s scientific infrastructure. The Lab-on-a-Chip (LoC) Facility is equipped with state-of-the-art microfabrication technologies housed within a cleanroom at MPZPM. LoC can also draw on the capabilities of another nanofabrication cleanroom facility at MPL. The unit supports researchers in developing advanced microfluidic chips, microtools and physiologically relevant microenvironments for studies at the interface of physics and medicine. We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Facility Head to manage and further develop the Lab-on-a-Chip facility. You will oversee daily operations, ensure safe and efficient laboratory workflows, support scientific users from diverse backgrounds and contribute to the design and development of innovative methodologies.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Management

Lead, mentor, and support scientific and technical staff, fostering a collaborative and high-performing team.
Oversee facility operations, including planning, budgeting, maintenance, and strategic development.
Train and support users from diverse scientific backgrounds.

Technical Expertise & Scientific Support

Ensure reliable operation of cleanroom infrastructure and microfabrication equipment.
Provide expert guidance in microfabrication, microfluidics, and lab-on-a-chip system development.
Contribute to the development of new microstructured materials, microfluidic chips, and advanced LoC technologies.

Innovation & Development

Support interdisciplinary research projects and facilitate knowledge transfer across scientific fields.
Develop novel microfluidics-based methodologies and provide SOPs to ensure reliable and reproducible use.
Propose and discuss organizational and infrastructure improvements with the MPZPM board, focusing on optimized workflows, state-of-the-art technologies, and strategic upgrades aligned with the institute’s priorities.
You bring:

MSc or PhD in physics, biophysics, chemistry, materials science, biomedical engineering, or a related field.
Experience in managing laboratories, particularly cleanrooms, including staff supervision and operation of microfabrication workflows.
Strong organizational, leadership, and project-management skills, with a track record of building or expanding scientific infrastructure.
Expertise in developing microfluidic technologies.
Capability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary and multicultural environment.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across scientific disciplines. English is the primary working language; knowledge of German is advantageous.
Experience in technology transfer, device development, or industry collaboration is a plus.

Ideal Technical Competencies (some of the following):

Microfabrication & Lithography: photolithography, soft lithography, micropatterning of rigid and soft materials, biomolecule patterning via microcontact printing or LIMA photopatterning.
Microfluidics & Lab-on-a-Chip Systems: design, production, and integration of microfluidic chips with fluidic, optical and electronic components.
Soft Material Microstructuring: hydrogels, droplet microfluidics, and other soft materials relevant to biomedical applications.
3D structuring using Digital Light Processing (DLP) and Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM).

jobs.occupation: Scientific Scouting Officer (HR Business Partner)
jobs.description:
The Max Planck Society for the Advancement of Science (Max Planck Gesellschaft, MPG) is a self-governing scientific organization funded by the Federal and State Governments. It conducts basic research in the fields of natural sciences, the humanities and the social sciences in 85 institutes and research units in Germany and abroad.

The MPG consists of three sections: the Biology and Medicine Section, the Chemistry, Physics and Technology Section and the Human Sciences Section. Each section has a Scientific Scouting Officer who supports the respective section and its institutes in identifying the next generation of leading researchers.

For the Human Sciences Section, the Administrative Headquarters of the MPG are now seeking a:

Scientific Scouting Officer (all genders) –

80% part‑time initially, with a potential full‑time transition effective 1 January 2029

(Reference Number 63/26)

to start as early as possible.

The Section includes a range of disciplines, notably the History of Art, Anthropology, Demography, Economics, the History of Science, Law, Neurosciences, Political Sciences, Psychology, and Sociology.

Your responsibilities

- Proactive and systematic identification of outstanding scientists to support the Human Sciences Section and its Core and Appointment Commissions
- Building and analyzing candidate pools, generating appropriate statistics
- Using various talent acquisition tools, including but not limited to internet sourcing, data mining, social media, networking at national and international conferences, as well as other creative methods to identify outstanding candidates
- Analyzing candidate lists generated through nomination calls
- Implementing, maintaining and further developing candidate databases together with the two Scouting Officers of the other section
- Attending international conferences, participating in public outreach to promote the MPG
- Complementing the current scouting team and actively participating in constantly developing the team’s scouting concept, tackling human sciences-oriented as well as interdisciplinary scouting projects

Your profile

- Doctoral degree in one of the scientific disciplines of the Human Sciences Section and several years of postdoctoral experience
- Education and/or postdoctoral research abroad, ideally for several years
- In-depth knowledge of the German and international research landscape (including organizational and research-specific framework conditions)
- Proven scientific track record and demonstrated knowledge of the respective scientific community
- General interest in a broad range of scientific subjects covered in the Human Sciences Section and ability to quickly familiarize yourself with new areas of research
- Solution-oriented, service-driven, creative and open-minded working style
- Excellent proficiency in English (written and spoken, level C1–C2) and good proficiency in German (minimum level B2)
- Excellent interpersonal communication and networking skills, in order to interact with and coordinate partners with diverse professional and multicultural backgrounds
- Experience in working with AI applications or a willingness to learn how to use such systems
- Willingness to adopt flexible working hours, as well as taking part in regular business travel in Germany and abroad
- Experience in scouting/​recruiting scientists would be desirable

Our offer

- You will gain fascinating insights into the outstanding research at our Max Planck Institutes.
- You will help to identify the next generation of outstanding scientists for the MPG by directly interacting with its leadership and directors.
- As a member of the Section Office, you will cooperate with the department "Institutes" at the Administrative Headquarters of the MPG.
- You will obtain an excellent overview of the entire spectrum of scientific administration and the structure of the German research landscape.

We are offering a payment up to salary level 14 of the collective wage agreement for the civil service (TVöD Bund) as well as various benefits.
This position is permanent and 80% part-time initially, with a potential full-time transition effective 1 January 2029. You will be based at the Administrative Headquarters of the MPG, located in the centre of Munich.

We offer a supportive work environment with flexible schedules, remote work options, and work-life balance. We invest in your professional growth through personalized development opportunities, health promotion programmes, and a company pension plan. Additional benefits include discounted public transportation passes and full access to standard public sector social benefits.

The Max Planck Society has set a goal of employing more people with severe disabilities. Applications from people with severe disabilities are expressly encouraged. The Max Planck Society is committed to gender equality and diversity. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Have we piqued your interest?

If you are interested, please send your complete online application (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/130734)  **(Reference Number 63/26)**, including a personalized cover letter, to our human resources department, indicating your possible starting date. We look forward to getting to know you.

Application deadline: 2 October 2026

jobs.occupation: Strategic Officer (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

The Department Pediatric Neurooncology is looking, starting from 01.11.2026, for a Strategic Officer.

The department led by Prof. Stefan Pfister at the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) and the Hopp Children’s Cancer Center Heidelberg (KiTZ) combines international pediatric oncology research with data-driven precision oncology and the development of sustainable research infrastructures.

A key international initiative of the department is the ITCC PedCanPortal, a data and research platform developed in collaboration with leading European partners in pediatric oncology. The project aims to bring together a large, international multi-omics dataset comprising molecular and clinical data from more than 5,000 patients and to make these high-quality research data, along with analytical tools, accessible and sustainably available to the international research community. In doing so, the ITCC PedCanPortal aims to support the development of new diagnostic and therapeutic approaches for children and adolescents with cancer.

The Strategic Officer will work at the interface of science, strategy, international partnerships, and the sustainable development of the ITCC PedCanPortal, with a particular focus on establishing the organizational and financial structures required for its long-term sustainability.

Your Tasks

As Strategy Officer, you will be embedded within the central coordination structure of ITCC PedCanPortal and work closely with the project leadership, international consortium partners, patient representatives, advisory bodies, and external stakeholders.

Your primary responsibility will be to develop, coordinate, and implement a comprehensive long-term continuity and implementation strategy for ITCC PedCanPortal beyond its current funding period (e.g., via a non-profit spin-off). Sustainability planning will be treated as a continuous and evolving process, closely aligned with the scientific, technical, ethical, and operational development of the platform.

Key responsibilities:

Strategic development and sustainability planning

- Develop and continuously refine a long-term continuity and implementation strategy for ITCC PedCanPortal
- Design governance and operational models for the future operation and expansion of the platform
- Evaluate and develop sustainable funding and partnership models
- Support the onboarding of future programs, projects, and stakeholders into the ITCC PedCanPortal ecosystem

Stakeholder management and international coordination

- Coordinate continuity-related activities across a large international consortium
- Facilitate interactions with academic partners, patient representatives, external stakeholders, and industry collaborators
- Support strategic discussions within governance and advisory structures
- Build and maintain strong relationships across the international pediatric oncology community

Governance, reporting, and implementation

- Ensure alignment of continuity planning with scientific, ethical, legal, and operational requirements
- Prepare strategic reports, recommendations, and implementation concepts for project leadership and governance bodies
- Contribute to annual reporting, risk assessment, and long-term planning activities
- Support the translation of strategic concepts into operational implementation plans

Your Profile

We are looking for a highly organized and strategically minded individual who enjoys working at the intersection of science, innovation and international collaboration.

Essential:

- PhD or 5+ years experience in life sciences, medicine, public health, health economics, management, law or a related discipline.
- Experience in scientific program management, research strategy, innovation management, business development or international collaborative projects.
- Excellent organizational and communication skills.
- Experience working with diverse stakeholder groups in complex international environments.
- Excellent written and spoken English.

Desirable:

- Experience with large-scale research infrastructures, data platforms or precision medicine initiatives.
- Understanding of governance, continuity planning and funding strategies.
- Experience in public-private partnerships, translational research or health innovation.
- Familiarity with biomedical research, pediatric oncology, genomics or health data ecosystems.

You can look forward to:

- The opportunity to help shape one of the world's leading pediatric cancer data platforms.
- A highly international and interdisciplinary working environment.
- Close interaction with internationally renowned experts in pediatric oncology, genomics, data science, ethics and patient advocacy.
- A unique strategic role with significant visibility and impact.
- Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development.
- Flexible working arrangements within a dynamic research environment.
- Join us in building the future of pediatric precision oncology and creating a sustainable international data infrastructure that will improve outcomes for children with cancer worldwide.

We Offer

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
- 30 days of vacation per year
- Flexible working hours
- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments
- Possibility of mobile work and part-time work
- Family-friendly working environment
- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket
- Unleash your full potential: targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents
- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being

Are you interested?

Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!

Contact:

Dr. Anna-Lisa Böttcher
Phone: 06221-42 4612

Duration: The position is initially limited to 2 years.

Application Deadline: 25.09.2026

Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.

Please also note that we cannot return applications submitted by post.

We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. People with severe disabilities are given preference if they have the same aptitude.

Notice: We are subject to the regulations of the Infection Protection Act (IfSG). Therefore, all our employees must provide proof of immunity against measles.

jobs.occupation: Senior QA Engineer (all genders) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Your creative fieldWe are looking for a full-time, permanent Senior QA Engineer (all genders) to start as soon as possible . We live remote-first within Germany, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations.

Contabo serves 180,000+ customers worldwide across VPS, dedicated servers, object storage and a growing cloud-native platform. Quality isn't a bottleneck function here – it's embedded in how we build.
You'll work across multiple development teams on products that vary significantly in architecture, maturity and risk profile. The scope is wide and the technical surface is real.

QA here means jumping between contexts and figuring things out, not just executing scripts against a stable codebase.
You come in before development starts: read the requirements, flag what's untestable and push back early.
You own the test strategy and update it as things change – not as a document exercise, but because the products actually change.

You write test plans and test cases, run manual tests (functional, regression, exploratory, UAT) and build and maintain automated tests across UI, API and integration.
We use AI tools actively: in development, in testing, in how we work day to day and we expect the same from you. That's not a trend we're chasing: it's how we stay fast without cutting corners on quality.

You keep the continuous testing pipelines running and help the teams use them. When bugs come up, you write bug reports that developers can actually work with – reproduction steps, impact, everything needed to close it without a follow-up ping.
Regular regression cycles after major releases are part of the job, as is running UAT with product stakeholders.

What convinces usYour personality, paired with:
• 5+ years in software testing/QA, ideally in agile teams
• Test automation in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript; hands-on with frameworks like Playwright, Frisby, or Supertest
• Experience using AI-assisted tools in development or testing (AI code generators, LLM-based test support or similar) and comfortable using Claude (or comparable LLMs) as part of your daily workflow
• Solid grasp of test design, QA processes, and translating requirements into test plans and test cases
• API testing (REST), Git, bug tracking, browser DevTools – these are daily tools for you
• Comfortable prioritizing across multiple test streams simultaneously
• Fluent English skills and German language skills would be a plus
• Experience with AI-assisted tools in testing or development
• UAT facilitation, QA process ownership, performance/integration testing

We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.

Awesome ProspectsAt Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.
What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.
Additionally, we offer:
• Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office
• Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca
• Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and thousands of fitness and wellness facilities
• Enjoy exclusive perks – Attractive discounts on many products and services through our corporate benefits program
• Recharge your energy – 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve
• Give back – An extra day off to get involved in social activities through our Volunteer Day
• Make an impact – Take ownership and bring your ideas to life with real creative freedom
• Keep growing – Individual professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative tech environment
• Feel comfortable where you work – Modern, conveniently located offices across our European locations
• Be part of a diverse team – Work in an international environment shaped by diversity
• Create lasting memories – Company events and team activities you won’t forget

How to reach usIf you have any questions, you can reach out to Alina by email at alina.peissl@contabo.de.

About us Contabo - High-quality Cloud Hosting Made in Germany!

As a leading infrastructure service provider in the field of cloud instances and dedicated servers, we have stood for first-class quality, reliability and favorable prices since our foundation in Munich in 2003. Meanwhile, more than 275,000 customers in over 190 countries trust our services.

We specialize in providing German quality to users worldwide, focusing on the stability and security of our data centers, the optimization of internal processes, and excellent customer support.

Become a part of our future-oriented company, which plays a significant role in the development of digital cloud hosting, and support us with your ideas and commitment.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc (m/f/d) – Translational Cancer Research | Gastroenterology (Bioinformatiker/in)
jobs.employer_name: Universitätsklinikum der Technischen Universität München AöR
jobs.description:
Postdoc (m/f/d) – Translational Cancer Research | Gastroenterology 

Full- or part-time | temporary (36 months) | Klinik und Poliklinik für Innere Medizin II, Gastroenterologie

The Department of Internal Medicine II at TUM Klinikum rechts der Isar is recruiting a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join our newly established Max Eder Research Group.

Our research aims to decipher the molecular mechanisms of tumor evolution, cellular plasticity, and therapy resistance in gastric and gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma (GEAC). By integrating longitudinal patient samples from prospective clinical trials with cutting-edge multi-omics technologies and functional model systems, our group is committed to understanding the biological mechanisms underlying treatment resistance in upper gastrointestinal cancers and translating these discoveries into novel therapeutic strategies.

The position offers the unique opportunity to work at the interface of clinical oncology, cancer genomics, computational biology, and functional cancer research within an outstanding translational research environment.

Your responsibilities:

You will investigate the molecular mechanisms of tumor evolution, cellular plasticity, and therapy resistance in GEAC through the integration of longitudinal multi-omics datasets from prospective clinical trial samples. 

Your research will focus on computational analysis and interpretation of large-scale molecular datasets, including:

- Analysis and integration of single-cell and spatial transcriptomic datasets to characterize tumor evolution and treatment response
- Inference of tissue-specific gene expression and tumor activity from plasma cell-free DNA fragmentation patterns
- Development of computational approaches for the integration of genomic, transcriptomic, epigenomic and immune profiling data
- Multi-omics integration to reconstruct tumor evolutionary trajectories and characterize cellular plasticity during treatment
- Development and implementation of bioinformatic pipelines for high-dimensional sequencing datasets
- Close collaboration with clinicians, biologists, computational biologists and international collaborators
- Presentation of research at international conferences and publication in high-impact scientific journals

Your profile:

We are seeking an ambitious computational scientist with a strong interest in translational cancer research and multi-omics data analysis.

Required qualifications

- PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Data Science, Biomedical Sciences, Cancer Genomics or a related quantitative discipline
- Strong experience in the analysis of next-generation sequencing data (e.g. transcriptomic and/or genomic datasets)
- Excellent programming skills in R and/or Python
- Experience working in Linux/Unix environments and using reproducible computational workflows
- Ability to independently design and drive scientific projects
- Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English

Preferred qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:

- Cell-free DNA sequencing and fragmentation analysis (highly desirable)
- Single-cell RNA sequencing analysis and/or Spatial transcriptomics
- Multi-omics integration
- Machine learning or statistical modelling of biological datasets
- Cancer genomics and tumor evolution

We offer you:

- A postdoctoral position within a newly established and rapidly growing Max Eder Research Group funded by the German Cancer Aid
- An outstanding translational research environment embedded within TUM Klinikum rechts der Isar, one of Europe’s leading academic medical centers
- Close collaboration with internationally renowned research groups at the Institute of Cancer Research (ICR), Sutton, UK, and Chalmers University of Technology, Gothenburg, Sweden, including opportunities for scientific exchange and short-term research stays at both partner institutions.
- Direct integration with prospective clinical trials and longitudinal patient cohorts
- Close collaboration with physicians, computational biologists and internationally recognized research partners
- Strong mentorship and excellent opportunities for scientific independence and career development
- Support for national and international conference attendance
- Competitive salary according to TV-L
- EGYM Wellpass, corporate benefits, company pension scheme (VBL), cafeteria, sports and cultural offers
- Modern workplace in the heart of Munich with excellent public transport connections

We look forward to your application!

Contact: Dr. Melissa Barroux | 089 / 4140 –2251 | Klinik und Poliklinik für Innere Medizin II, Gastroenterologie

jobs.occupation: Mission & Armament Commodity Manager (d/f/m) (Einkäufer/in)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

A vacancy has arisen in the lines of our Commodity Managers within strategic procurement, which is a vital part in the procurement and supply chain community.

Commodity Manager in Strategic Procurement (d/f/m)

You will join the Mission & Armament commodity for systems procurement for all Airbus Defence and Space AirPower platforms, which will give you a unique wide vision of the Airbus Defence and Space AirPower current and future business. You will work developing structural relationships with well established worldwide suppliers and managing complex workpackages.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Build the future Supply Chain of Combat Collaborative Aircrafts and lead national eyes only projects from the procurement side
- Establish, implement & monitor a Commodity strategy for your perimeter
- Lead the (Sub-) Commodity Multi-Functional Team
- Manage supplier relationships and supplier related development programs
- Lead negotiations with supplier to assure program expectations are meet
- Set-up, negotiate and manage contractual agreements with suppliers

Desired skills and qualifications

- 3-5 years of experience within Procurement
- Bachelor/ Master degree in Business Administration, Engineering or comparable
- Languages: German: mother tongue, English: Negotiation level
- very good skills in (international) communication
- Excellent negotiation skills and the ability to persuade, influence and convince
- Able to anticipate, assess and mitigate risks

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

#MYCYM

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Head of PMO / Chief of Projects (m/f/d) (Leiter/in - Projekt-/Programmmanagement)
jobs.description:
AURELIUS is a global alternative investor, distinguished and widely recognised for its operational approach. It focuses on private markets, in particular Private Equity and Private Debt. Its key investment platforms include AURELIUS Opportunities V, AURELIUS European Opportunities IV, AUR Portfolio III and AURELIUS Growth (Wachstumskapital). AURELIUS has been growing significantly in recent years, especially expanding its global footprint, and today employs more than 400 professionals in 10 offices spanning Europe, North America and Asia.

AURELIUS is driven by a spirit of entrepreneurship, with a collegiate, hands-on approach to complex projects. We are motivated, open, fun, and operate as a team of equals.

Create impact with passion!

For an AURELIUS’ portfolio company located in Bavaria we are looking for a

Head of PMO / Chief of Projects (m/f/d)

As a Head of PMO you will lead and professionalize the end-to-end Project Management / Delivery function across the EMEA utilities business, spanning residential and industrial energy tech, software, and analytics solutions. You will own delivery from project definition through mass production and customer rollout, integrating Sales, Product Management, R&D, NPI, Procurement, and Quality into one disciplined execution engine. Furthermore, you will transform a currently fragmented, product- and site-centric delivery model into a standardized, cross-BU project delivery organization with clear stage gates, transparent KPIs, and predictable outcomes. The Head of PMO will act as the single accountable owner like a “project CEO” for on-time, on-quality, and on-cost delivery of projects and new product introductions, and as the primary interface to major customers for delivery commitments. Your task is to drive execution discipline, cost control, and margin protection across the full project lifecycle. The role requires frequent travel.

Responsibilities

1. Project Delivery Leadership & Organizational Ownership

- Lead and develop the EMEA Project Delivery organization across customer projects, NPI, and cross-BU solution programs
- Define and implement the organizational setup, governance model, and PM career path, including near-/offshore delivery capacity
- Build a balanced delivery organization combining hardware project management, software/solution delivery, and NPI program management
- Ensure scalability, agility, and clear accountability across all delivery units and sites

2. End-to-End Engineering Delivery

- Own end-to-end delivery from project definition through development, industrialization, mass production ramp, and customer handover
- Act as the single point of accountability for on-time, on-quality, on-cost execution of customer projects and NPIs
- Drive execution discipline, cost control, and scalable delivery models across multi-site and multi-BU programs
- Establish a common project lifecycle, stage-gate framework, and PMO standards applied consistently across electricity, gas, thermal, software, and analytics
- Ensure robust project planning, risk management, change control, and claim management on all major programs
- Chair stage-gate reviews and enforce go/no-go decisions against scope, schedule, cost, quality, and business case

3. Cross-BU Solution Delivery (HW + SW + Analytics)

- Lead delivery of integrated solutions combining residential and industrial meters, head-end software, and analytics offerings
- Break down BU silos and orchestrate cross-BU program teams around customer outcomes, not product lines
- Establish shared solution architectures and reusable delivery playbooks across product families
- Ensure consistent solution scoping, pricing input, and delivery commitments across the portfolio

4. NPI & Industrialization

- Collaborate with Operations on NPI program management from early involvement design, to design freeze through pilot, ramp, and stable serial production
- Ensure early and structured involvement of NPI, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Quality in R&D projects
- Drive design-for-manufacturing, design-for-cost, and design-for-serviceability discipline into every new program
- Manage ramp readiness: supply readiness, test coverage, production line qualification, and yield curves

5. Cross-functional Collaboration

- Act as the delivery counterpart to Product Management (portfolio & roadmap) and R&D (technology execution)
- Partner with Sales and Customer Projects to translate customer commitments into feasible, margin-protected delivery plans
- Provide delivery input into bids, contract negotiation, and commercial terms (milestones, LDs, acceptance criteria)
- Collaborate with Procurement and SCM to secure supply, lead times, and cost targets for project ramp
- Collaborate with Quality to embed quality gates and field-performance feedback into delivery governance
- Align with Finance on project controlling, revenue recognition, milestone billing, and cash collection

6. Financial & Resource Management

- Own the project delivery cost base and the aggregated margin performance of the project portfolio
- Drive project margin protection: budget adherence, contingency management, scope and change control
- Optimize allocation of PM and delivery resources across customer projects and NPI programs
- Drive build vs. buy vs. outsource decisions for delivery capacity, balancing control, cost, and flexibility
- Support business cases and mid-term planning with realistic delivery assumptions and risk-adjusted estimates

7. Transformation & Change Leadership

- Lead transformation initiatives to increase delivery productivity, reduce time-to-market, and improve predictability
- Standardize and digitalize PMO tooling (planning, reporting, risk, resource management)
- Build a high-performance, accountable, and customer-centric delivery culture
- Drive upskilling and certification of the PM community across hardware, software, and solution delivery

8. Governance, Risk & Compliance

- Ensure project delivery complies with contractual, regulatory, cybersecurity, and quality requirements
- Establish transparent portfolio reporting to the CEO and executive team, including early warning on at-risk programs
- Own risk register for the delivery portfolio and drive systematic mitigation

Your Profile

Professional Experience

- Minimum 15+ years of experience in project, program, and delivery leadership, including senior roles (VP/SVP level) in an international, matrix organization
- Proven track record leading large-scale, cross-functional delivery organizations spanning hardware, software, and integrated solutions
- Significant experience in customer project delivery in a B2B environment (preferably utilities, energy, industrial technology, or telecom infrastructure)
- Strong NPI and industrialization background: bringing new hardware and software products from development into serial production and customer rollout
- Demonstrated success in owning end-to-end delivery from project definition to mass production and customer acceptance
- Experience running structured stage-gate and PMO frameworks at scale, with measurable improvements in OTD, margin, and predictability
- Solid commercial acumen: contract, bid, and claim management; project P&L ownership; milestone billing and working capital control
- Experience in driving organizational transformation and productivity improvements (cost, efficiency, time-to-market)
- Experience in global/multi-site setups, including near-/offshore delivery structures
- Exposure to carve-out, integration, or major transformation programs (strong plus)

Intercultural Experience

- Proven leadership experience in international and cross-cultural environments, managing teams across multiple geographies
- Strong experience in navigating matrix organizations and global governance structures
- High level of cultural awareness, adaptability, and communication effectiveness at executive and customer level
- Fluency in German and English is a prerequisite

Personal attributes

- University degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
- Advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is a plus; recognized PM certifications (PMP, IPMA, PgMP, SAFe) are a plus
- Strong technical understanding across hardware, embedded systems, software, and cloud/analytics solutions — able to challenge and steer technical trade-offs
- Deep mastery of project and program management methods, stage-gate governance, and modern delivery models (Agile at scale, hybrid HW/SW delivery)
- Proven ability to drive execution at scale in multi-site, distributed delivery organizations, including vendor and outsourcing management
- Data-driven delivery mindset: use of KPIs, portfolio dashboards, and analytics to improve OTD, quality, and productivity
- Strong business and P&L awareness, with ability to protect and expand project margin under commercial pressure
- Ability to connect customer commitments, technical execution, and financial outcomes
- Strong ROI orientation: able to challenge scope, prioritize based on value, and terminate programs that no longer meet hurdle rates
- Strong decision-making capability under ambiguity, especially in evolving organizational and carve-out setups
- Excellent stakeholder management skills across CEO / board level, customers, suppliers, and internal functions
- High degree of resilience and change leadership capability in transformation environments
- Ability to attract, develop, and retain top program and delivery talent
